summary: From the answers given, outbound data, inbound data, and login are unknown, so readiness is mid to low. We did not look up this portal.
why_this_route: Software picked the browser path because the answers did not list a documented API or an export. That is a fact from the form, not from the product name.
setup_steps: Ask the vendor which access path they support for this task.
Leave unknown fields marked unknown until they reply.
Create a dedicated login only after the vendor confirms it is allowed.
Run a supervised pilot on last week's list if a sanctioned path exists.

risks.risk: Assuming capabilities from the product name would invent facts.
risks.mitigation: Stay with the form answers and put gaps in the vendor questions.

human_checkpoints: A person sends the vendor questions before any live run
pilot: Send the vendor questions and keep this week's export manual.
